name: Clearscope
description_en:
Clearscope connects topic research and SERP-based content analysis with an editor, AI-assisted drafting and a monitored inventory of published pages. It also markets AI-query visibility tracking. The central object is a Draft analysis for a chosen query and locale; its recommendations guide editing but do not publish a page or establish a ranking result.

A useful evaluation takes one content question through intent review, a tailored outline, factual editing and post-publication monitoring with a verified Search Console property. Distinguish a competitor-based Content Grade from measured clicks and the platform’s modeled SEO value. Current pricing and help pages contain version differences, including older add-on examples. This profile records those limits without a signup, generated draft, connected property or publishing action.
description_zh:
Clearscope 将主题研究及 SERP 内容分析与编辑器、AI 辅助起草及已发布页面库存监控连接，也宣传 AI 查询可见性跟踪。核心对象是针对查询及地区的 Draft 分析，其建议辅助编辑，不发布页面，也不确定排名结果。

适合评估的是一个内容问题经过意图核查、定制提纲、事实编辑及使用已验证 Search Console 属性的发布后监控。需区分基于竞品的 Content Grade、实测点击及平台模型 SEO value。当前价格及帮助页有版本差异，含较旧加购示例。本条记录限制，未注册、生成稿、连接属性或发布。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current Essentials $129/month: 50 tracked queries, 50 pages, 20 monthly Topic Explorations and 20 Drafts. Business $399/month: 300 queries/pages, 50 explorations and 20 Drafts plus account manager. Enterprise custom. Unlimited users/projects, fourteen-day trial; card requirement not verified. Add-on cards show page rates $25/$15 monthly and Draft rates $50/$20, but selected pack sizes are not readable, so no unit price inferred. Help says excess-use add-ons auto-bill and an older example uses $189/100 pages. Currency code, exact taxes, refunds and account-specific checkout not established; no normalized price.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Topic discovery and the current ranking set are separate steps
sections.title_zh: 主题发现与当前排名集合是独立步骤
sections.en: Topic Exploration accepts a topic, URL or custom keyword list and provides topic groups, volume signals and intent views. A URL-based exploration is not a list of what that page currently ranks for. Search intent groupings can expose ambiguous meanings or incompatible result formats. Draft analysis then requires a specific query, locale/language and optional city/state/region. The guide describes a live top-thirty desktop/mobile SERP analysis. Editorial brief: choose the audience question and intended format before adopting terms or competitor outlines. A large suggested keyword set is not evidence that one page should serve every intent or that its volume converts to customers.
sections.zh: Topic Exploration 接受主题、URL 或词列表，展示主题组、搜索量信号及意图视图。URL 探索不是该页当前排名词表，意图组可显示歧义或不兼容结果形式。Draft 分析再选具体查询、地区／语言及可选城市／州／区域，指南描述实时前三十桌面／移动 SERP 分析。编辑简报：采用术语或竞品提纲前明确受众问题及形式。大型建议词表不证明一页应服务全部意图，也不证明搜索量转客户。

sections.title_en: The outline remains an editorial decision
sections.en: After analysis, start manually, optimize an existing Inventory page or use Draft with AI. The guided path selects searcher intent, content type and tone from a page, sample or default. The title shapes the proposed outline, whose headings can be edited, removed, reordered or supplemented. Exporting that outline as a brief is a separate choice from generating a complete draft. Editorial first pass: add first-party examples and missing constraints before generation, then check every factual claim and reference afterward. Matching an existing page’s tone or format does not establish factual accuracy, originality or permission to reuse its content.
sections.zh: 分析后可手写、优化库存已有页或用 Draft with AI。引导流程选搜索意图、内容形式及来自网页／样本／默认的语气。标题影响拟议提纲，可改删、重排或加标题，导提纲作简报与生成完整稿是独立选择。编辑初稿：生成前加第一方案例及缺失约束，之后核全部事实及引用。匹配已有页语气或形式不确定事实准确、原创或内容复用权限。

sections.title_en: A higher grade is not a fact-check or publishing approval
sections.title_zh: 高分不是事实核查或发布批准
sections.en: The Editor updates term coverage, grade, word count and readability as you write. Its highest listed Content Grade is A++; recommended length reflects analyzed competitors, and readability is a formula-based estimate. AI Term Presence opens an AI response using a suggested term, while Research and Outline provide questions, sources and competitor headings. Editorial revision: inspect why a term belongs, remove repetition and check cited originals rather than adding every phrase merely to raise the score. A term appearing in Gemini/GPT output does not establish that the source is correct or that your page will be cited.
sections.zh: 编辑时更新术语覆盖、分数、词数及可读性，最高列 A++，建议篇幅来自所分析竞品，可读性是公式估计。AI Term Presence 可打开含建议词的 AI 回答，Research／Outline 提供问题、来源及竞品标题。编辑修订：审术语为何适用、去重复及查原始引用，不能只为加分塞全部短语。术语出现在 Gemini／GPT 回答不确定来源正确，也不确定你的页面会被引用。

sections.title_en: Shared Draft access differs from a Google document’s edit permission
sections.title_zh: Draft 分享访问不同于 Google 文档编辑权
sections.en: A Shared Draft Link gives Guest Mode access without a Clearscope login. The Google Docs integration specifically requires that shared link plus editing permission to the actual Google document, a desktop browser and permitted Google OAuth/Workspace configuration. The link grants the Draft, not other Clearscope account permissions; Admins can automatically share new Drafts. WordPress separately requires an installed plugin, appropriate CMS access and linking the shared Draft in Classic or Gutenberg. Editorial collaboration: review shared-link settings, the destination document and account identity independently. A working Clearscope link does not grant Google-document editing or prove a CMS post was published.
sections.zh: Shared Draft Link 提供无需 Clearscope 登录的 Guest Mode。Google Docs 集成另需该链接、真实文档编辑权、桌面浏览器及允许的 OAuth／Workspace 配置。链接只授 Draft，不授账户其他权限，Admin 可设新稿自动分享。WordPress 另需安装插件、适当 CMS 权限及在 Classic／Gutenberg 关联共享稿。编辑协作：分别审分享设置、目标文档及账户身份。Clearscope 链接可用不授 Google 文档编辑，也不证明 CMS 已发布。

sections.title_en: Automated import can expand monitored-page usage
sections.title_zh: 自动导入可扩展被监控页面用量
sections.en: Connect a verified GSC property and choose the matching locale for a new Inventory project. Pages can be added manually with chosen queries or by subdirectory, with optional future automatic importing. Initial setup can take up to half an hour. Clearscope assigns a best-fit query, which the editor can replace when it misses the page’s objective. Editorial setup: start with representative URLs, check the assigned query and imported properties, and inspect page capacity before enabling future imports. A verified connection does not mean every imported page has the right target query, and automatic additions must be considered alongside documented add-on billing.
sections.zh: 新库存项目连接已验证 GSC 属性并选匹配地区。可手动加页及查询，或按子目录导入并可启未来自动导入，首次设置可需半小时。Clearscope 指派最佳匹配查询，偏离页面目标时可替换。编辑设置：先用代表 URL，查查询及导入属性，启未来导入前审页面容量。验证连接不代表每页目标词正确，自动追加也需结合文档加购计费。

sections.title_en: Daily regrading does not mean daily SERP refresh
sections.title_zh: 每日重评不代表每日刷新 SERP
sections.en: Inventory grades each monitored query against the SERP collected when the page was added, then regrades published content daily against that original set. The detailed guide says a new SERP is fetched every thirty days. A newly created Draft instead preserves the SERP snapshot from its creation time. Editorial grade discrepancy: compare target query, locale, published content and analysis dates before rerunning or rewriting. A changed competitor set can alter a grade without a page edit; an unchanged grade between SERP refreshes does not prove that the live search landscape stayed unchanged.
sections.zh: 库存对每监控词用加页时 SERP 评分，再每天对原集合重评已发布内容。详细指南称每三十天取新 SERP，新 Draft 则保留创建时快照。编辑分数差异检查：重跑或重写前比目标词、地区、已发布正文及分析日期。竞品集合变化可在未改页时改分，两次 SERP 刷新间分数未变也不证明真实搜索环境未变。

sections.title_en: SEO value and Content Decay are investigation aids
sections.title_zh: SEO value 与 Content Decay 辅助调查
sections.en: Inventory joins GSC clicks, impressions and target-query position with content grades. SEO value multiplies GSC clicks by average CPC; it is a modeled traffic-value estimate rather than measured revenue. Content Decay compares the latest ninety-day clicks with the same window a year earlier and supplies a twelve-month sparkline. Views dynamically reflect saved filters; annotations and surfaced algorithm/model changes add context. Editorial refresh queue: examine seasonal change, query intent and actual page quality before choosing an update. A negative year-on-year result or nearby annotation does not by itself diagnose stale writing or prove a specific edit caused the decline.
sections.zh: 库存将 GSC 点击、展示及目标词位置与内容分数连接，SEO value 用 GSC 点击乘平均 CPC，是模型流量价值，不是实测收入。Content Decay 比最近九十天与上年同窗点击，并有十二月趋势线。视图按保存筛选动态更新，注释及显示的算法／模型变化供语境。编辑刷新队列：决定更新前审季节变化、查询意图及真实页面质量。同比负结果或邻近注释不能独立诊断正文过旧或证明某次编辑造成下降。

sections.title_en: AI query monitoring has an incompletely documented measurement method
sections.title_zh: AI 查询监控的测量方法尚未完整公开核实
sections.en: The Expand product page describes tracking brand mentions across ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude using rolling averages; the pricing page names ChatGPT and Gemini. This public research did not establish collection mode, exact models, run cadence, alias matching, aggregation weights or the custom-query add-on unit. Editorial evaluation: preserve the exact question, platform and observation date, inspect the source answer, and distinguish a mention from a linked citation or measured referral. A rolling mention percentage is a panel result, not an audited share of all AI conversations. Full three-platform entitlement remains an account-level check.
sections.zh: Expand 产品页描述 ChatGPT、Gemini 及 Claude 提及跟踪及滚动平均，价格页仅列 ChatGPT／Gemini。本研究未确定采集模式、准确模型、运行周期、别名匹配、汇总权重或自定义查询加购单位。编辑评估：保留准确问题、平台及观察日期、审原回答，区分提及、链接引用及实测引荐。滚动提及百分比是面板结果，不是全部 AI 对话经审计份额。三平台完整权益仍需账户核查。

sections.title_en: A Draft credit pays for analysis, not necessarily one generated article
sections.title_zh: Draft 积分用于分析，不等于一篇生成文章
sections.en: Run uses one Topic Exploration credit; Create Draft uses one credit for current SERP/competitor analysis. Monthly unused exploration/draft credits do not roll over; annual plans expose the yearly pool upfront. Inventory pages are a persistent monitored capacity. The add-on guide says exceeding included types automatically adjusts billing, but its $189 Essentials example differs from the current $129 card, and its capacity wording differs from the credits guide’s hard allotment. Editorial budget: check actual Billing & credits and add-on pack quantities before bulk analysis or auto-import. Do not quote the old example as today’s price or assume every unlimited user has unlimited analysis.
sections.zh: Run 用一个 Topic Exploration 积分，Create Draft 用一个当前 SERP／竞品分析积分。月度未用探索／草稿积分不结转，年付预先开放全年池，库存页为持续监控容量。加购指南称超过包含类别自动调账，但其 $189 Essentials 示例与当前 $129 卡不同，容量措辞也与积分指南的分配硬限不同。编辑预算：批量分析或自动导入前核真实 Billing & credits 及加购包数量，不能将旧示例报作现价，也不能认为不限用户等于不限分析。

sections.title_en: Role, document permission and crawler access have different recovery paths
sections.title_zh: 角色、文档权限及爬虫访问有不同恢复路径
sections.en: An Admin is an account owner and can edit user roles in organizational settings. If the sole Admin has left, the guide directs the team to support. Google Docs errors such as admin_policy_enforced point to Workspace configuration; inspect the authorized Google account and document edit permission before relinking. For Inventory retrieval, Clearscopebot fetches public content and documents robots.txt compliance and firewall-related blockers. Editorial troubleshooting: identify which layer failed and retain the error and target URL. Recreating a Draft is not a documented universal remedy for an inaccessible page, blocked add-on or lost account administration.
sections.zh: Admin 即账户所有者，可在组织设置改用户角色，唯一 Admin 离职时指南转支持。Google Docs 的 admin_policy_enforced 等错误指 Workspace 配置，重关联前查授权 Google 账户及文档编辑权。库存取页由 Clearscopebot 抓公开内容，文档列遵守 robots.txt 及防火墙阻挡。编辑排查：确定失败层并保留错误及目标 URL，重建 Draft 不是页面不可访问、插件被阻或账户管理丢失的通用文档修复。

sections.title_en: Help and terms describe different exit and retrieval windows
sections.title_zh: 帮助及条款描述不同退出／取回窗口
sections.en: The cancellation guide uses Billing & credits and a confirmation email, with access ending after the paid period. Pause help says there is no account-pause mode; monthly reactivation within twelve months restores history. Terms instead describe thirty-day advance termination notice and thirty-day post-termination electronic data retrieval. These published statements do not establish one consistent timeline, and legal enforceability was not assessed. Editorial exit: export required drafts while access is active and confirm actual renewal, access and retrieval dates with the account agreement. A no-contract pricing slogan does not resolve the documented notice or data-access conflict.
sections.zh: 取消指南通过 Billing & credits 及确认邮件，已付期后失访问。暂停帮助称无暂停模式，月付取消后十二个月内恢复可找回历史。条款却描述提前三十天终止通知及终止后三十天电子取回数据。这些公开说明不能确定统一时间线，未评法律效力。编辑退出：仍有访问时导所需稿，按账户协议核真实续费、访问及取回日期。“无合同”价格口号不能解决通知或数据访问冲突。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
